subject: mm-pbsa calculation: SA Bomb in circle(): Stored surface arcs over limit

messages.author: Serena Vittorio
messages.body:
Dear Amber Users,
I am trying to run some mm-pbsa calculations and I obtained the following message in the pbsa out file:
SA Bomb in circle(): Stored surface arcs over limit
What could be the cause and how can I fix it?
Thanks in advance.
Best regards,
Serena

messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Mon, Oct 19, 2020, Serena Vittorio wrote:
>
>
>SA Bomb in circle(): Stored surface arcs over limit
Wow: I haven't seen this error reported before. Do you have a really
big system? Does it fail in this way on every snapshot? Try to create
an example that fails, just running pbsa on a single snapshot, not the
entire mm-pbsa script. (I'm assuming here that the error is in pbsa; if
not, find the code that is actually failing, and look for anything odd.)
....dac
